title: Final speed after catapult
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (1) must be 12 m/s.

title: Catapult zone length
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (2) must be 12 m.

title: Total runway length
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (3) must be 156 m.

title: Correct net force calculation
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the net force in each zone, accounting for thrust, catapult force, and constant friction.

title: Kinematics setup for two zones
description: Important: The student must set up correct kinematic equations linking velocities, accelerations, distances, and the given 4-second time difference.

title: Friction force value
description: Important: The student must correctly state the constant friction force as 0.2mg (4.0e4 N).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All intermediate calculations and final answers should use consistent SI units (m, s, m/s, m/s², N).

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly adds/subtracts the friction force direction in Newton's second law.

title: Misinterpreting time relation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student misapplies the condition that the later phase time is 4 seconds longer than the catapult phase time.
